chapterInfo.content:
12
Asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ din
1 # Esra 2.2 Na yeinom ne asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ a wɔne Sealtiel ba Serubabel ne Yesua foro baeɛ no: Seraia, Yeremia, Esra, 2Amaria, Maluk, Hatus, 3Sekania, Rehum, Meremot, 4#Luka 1.5 Ido, Ginetoi, Abia, 5Miamin, Maadia, Bilga, 6Semaia, Yoiarib, Yedaia, 7Salu, Amok, Hilkia, Yedaia. Yeinom ne asɔfoɔ no ne wɔn nuanom atitire, Yesua berɛ so.
8 # Neh 11.17 Na Lewifoɔ no: Yesua, Binui, Kadmiel, Serebia, Yuda, Matania a ɔdi aseda nnwom no soɔ, ɔne ne nuanom, 9na Bakbukia ne Uno, wɔn nuanom, di wɔn ntentensoɔ, ɔwɛn no mu. 10#Neh 12.1, 26; 3.1, 20 Na Yesua woo Yoiakim, na Yoiakim woo Eliasib, na Eliasib woo Yoiada, 11na Yoiada woo Yonatan, na Yonatan woo Yadua.
12Na Yoiakim berɛ so no, na asɔfoɔ no agyanom atitire nie: Seraia fam, Meraia; Yeremia deɛ: Hanania; 13Esra deɛ: Mesulam; Amaria deɛ: Yehohanan; 14Maluki deɛ: Yonatan; Sebania deɛ: Yosef; 15Harim deɛ: Adna; Meraiot deɛ: Helkai; 16Ido deɛ: Sakaria; Gineton deɛ: Mesulam; 17Abia deɛ: Sikri; Miniamin deɛ, Moadia deɛ: Piltai; 18Bilga deɛ: Samua; Semaia deɛ: Yehonatan; 19Yoiarib deɛ: Matenai; Yedaia deɛ: Usi; 20Salai deɛ: Kalai; Amok deɛ: Eber; 21Hilkia deɛ: Hasabia: Yedaia deɛ: Natanel.
22 # Neh 12.10-11 Lewifoɔ no: Eliasib, Yoiada, Yohanan ne Yadua berɛ so na wɔtwerɛɛ agyanom atitire no, asɔfoɔ no nso, wɔtwerɛɛ wɔn deɛ Persiani Dario ahennie so. 23Lewi mma, agyanom atitire no, wɔatwerɛ no berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu de abɛsi Eliasib ba Yohanan berɛ so. 24#1 Be 25; 2 Be 29.25 Na Lewifoɔ mu atitire: Hasabia, Serebia ne Kadmiel ba Yesua, ne wɔn nuanom a wɔdi wɔn ntentensoɔ no yi ayɛ da ase sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn nipa Dawid hyɛeɛ no, awɛmfoɔ kuo ne kuo: 25#Neh 11.17, 19; 2 Be 8.14; 1 Be 26.15, 17 Matania, Bakbukia, Obadia; Mesulam, Talmon, Akub a wɔwɛn apono ano ahwɛfoɔ wɛn, apono anoboadan no mu. 26#Neh 12.10; 1 Be 6.14-15; Neh 5.14; Esra 7.1-6 Yeinom wɔ Yosadak ba Yesua ba Yoiakim berɛ so ne Amrado Nehemia ne Ɔsɔfoɔ Esra, ɔtwerɛfoɔ no berɛ so.
Ɔfasuo no dwira
27Na wɔrebɛdwira Yerusalem fasuo no, wɔhwehwɛɛ Lewifoɔ no firi wɔn tenabea nyinaa, sɛ wɔde wɔn reba Yerusalem, na wɔde aseda ne nnwom, nnawuro, mmɛnta ne asankuten adi odwiratwa no anigyeɛ mu. 28Na nnwontofoɔ mma no boaa wɔn ho ano hyiae firi Yerusalem ho kanko no mu ne Netofafoɔ nkuraase, 29ne Bet-gilgal ne Geba mfofowa so ne Asmawet, ɛfiri sɛ na nnwontofoɔ no abobɔ nkuraa de atwa Yerusalem ho ahyia. 30Na asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no dwiraa wɔn ho, na wɔdwiraa ɔman ne kuro apono ne afasuo no.
31 # Neh 2.13; 3.13 Na memaa Yuda mmapɔmma no foroo ɔfasuo no, na mede aseda asafokuo akɛseɛ mmienu a wɔnam yuu sisii hɔ, baako faa nifa ɔfasuo no so de kɔɔ Sumina Pono no ano, 32na Hosaia ne Yuda mmapɔmma fa dii wɔn akyi kɔe 33ne Asaria, Esra ne Mesulam, 34Yuda ne Benyamin ne Semaia ne Yeremia, 35ne asɔfoɔ mma no mu binom a wɔkurakura ntotorobɛnto, Yonatan ba Sakaria, Semaia ba, Matania ba, Mikaia ba, Sakur ba, Asaf ba, 36ne ne nuanom, Semaia ne Asarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Natanel ne Yuda, Hanani, wɔkurakura Nyankopɔn nipa Dawid nsankuo no, na Ɔtwerɛfoɔ Esra di wɔn anim. 37#Neh 3.26 Na nsuo Aniwa Pono no so ne wɔn ntentensoɔ no wɔforoo Dawid kuro aforoeɛ no, ɔfasuo no aforoeɛ no so, Dawid fie no atifi de kɔsii Nsuo Pono no ano apueeɛ.
38 # Neh 3.11 Na aseda asafokuo a ɛtɔ so mmienu no kɔɔ wɔn ntentensoɔ, na me nso medii wɔn akyi, ne ɔman no fa no, ɔfasuo no so de kɔfaa Afononoo Abantenten no so de kɔsii Ɔfasuo Tɛtrɛtɛ no so, 39de kɔfaa Efraim Pono ne Ɛpono Dada ne Mpataa Pono ne Hananel Abantenten ne Ɔha Abantenten no so de kɔsii Nnwan Pono no ano, na wɔkɔgyinaa Nneduadan Pono no ano. 40Ɛnna aseda asafokuo mmienu no kɔgyinaa Nyankopɔn fie, me ne mmapɔmma no fa a wɔka me ho, 41ne asɔfoɔ no: Eliakim, Maaseia, Miniamin, Mikaia, Elioenai, Sakaria, Hanania a wɔkurakura ntotorobɛnto; 42ne Maaseia, Semaia, Eleasa, Usi, Yehohanan, Malkia, Elam ne Eser; na nnwontofoɔ no memaa wɔn nne so, na Yisrahia ne wɔn so kannifoɔ. 43Na wɔbobɔɔ afɔdeɛ akɛseɛ da no, na wɔn ani gyee, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn de anigyeɛ kɛseɛ agye wɔn ani; na mmaa ne mmɔfra nso ani gyee, na wɔtee Yerusalem anigyeɛ no nka akyirikyiri.
Asɔrefie akyɛdeɛ so ahwɛfoɔ
44 # Neh 10.36; 13.5 Na ɛda no ara wɔde mmarima bi sisii akoradeɛ ne mmasoɔ adeɛ ne aduanekan ne ntotosoɔ du du mpia no so, sɛ wɔmmoaboa nkuro no mfuo mu kyɛfa a mmara no hyɛeɛ no ano ngu mu mma asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no, ɛfiri sɛ Yuda nyaa asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ a wɔsisii wɔn no ho anigyeɛ. 45Na wɔyɛɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn som adwuma ne ahodwira ho som adwuma sɛ nnwontofoɔ ne apono ano ahwɛfoɔ no nso, sɛdeɛ Dawid ne ne ba Salomo hyɛeɛ no. 46#1 Be 25 Na tete no, Dawid berɛ so no, na Asaf ne nnwontofoɔ ne Nyankopɔn ayeyie ne aseda so otitire. 47#Neh 10.38 Na Serubabel ne Nehemia berɛ so no, Israel nyinaa memaa nnwontofoɔ ne apono ano ahwɛfoɔ no kyɛfa, da biara ne ne deɛ, na wɔde akronkronneɛ maa Lewifoɔ, na Lewifoɔ no nso de akronkronneɛ maa Aaron mma.

Na yeinom ne asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ a wɔne Sealtiel ba Serubabel ne Yesua foro baeɛ no: Seraia, Yeremia, Esra, Amaria, Maluk, Hatus, Sekania, Rehum, Meremot, Ido, Ginetoi, Abia, Miamin, Maadia, Bilga, Semaia, Yoiarib, Yedaia, Salu, Amok, Hilkia, Yedaia. Yeinom ne asɔfoɔ no ne wɔn nuanom atitire, Yesua berɛ so.
Na Lewifoɔ no: Yesua, Binui, Kadmiel, Serebia, Yuda, Matania a ɔdi aseda nnwom no soɔ, ɔne ne nuanom, na Bakbukia ne Uno, wɔn nuanom, di wɔn ntentensoɔ, ɔwɛn no mu. Na Yesua woo Yoiakim, na Yoiakim woo Eliasib, na Eliasib woo Yoiada, na Yoiada woo Yonatan, na Yonatan woo Yadua.
Na Yoiakim berɛ so no, na asɔfoɔ no agyanom atitire nie: Seraia fam, Meraia; Yeremia deɛ: Hanania; Esra deɛ: Mesulam; Amaria deɛ: Yehohanan; Maluki deɛ: Yonatan; Sebania deɛ: Yosef; Harim deɛ: Adna; Meraiot deɛ: Helkai; Ido deɛ: Sakaria; Gineton deɛ: Mesulam; Abia deɛ: Sikri; Miniamin deɛ, Moadia deɛ: Piltai; Bilga deɛ: Samua; Semaia deɛ: Yehonatan; Yoiarib deɛ: Matenai; Yedaia deɛ: Usi; Salai deɛ: Kalai; Amok deɛ: Eber; Hilkia deɛ: Hasabia: Yedaia deɛ: Natanel.
Lewifoɔ no: Eliasib, Yoiada, Yohanan ne Yadua berɛ so na wɔtwerɛɛ agyanom atitire no, asɔfoɔ no nso, wɔtwerɛɛ wɔn deɛ Persiani Dario ahennie so. Lewi mma, agyanom atitire no, wɔatwerɛ no berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu de abɛsi Eliasib ba Yohanan berɛ so. Na Lewifoɔ mu atitire: Hasabia, Serebia ne Kadmiel ba Yesua, ne wɔn nuanom a wɔdi wɔn ntentensoɔ no yi ayɛ da ase sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn nipa Dawid hyɛeɛ no, awɛmfoɔ kuo ne kuo: Matania, Bakbukia, Obadia; Mesulam, Talmon, Akub a wɔwɛn apono ano ahwɛfoɔ wɛn, apono anoboadan no mu. Yeinom wɔ Yosadak ba Yesua ba Yoiakim berɛ so ne Amrado Nehemia ne Ɔsɔfoɔ Esra, ɔtwerɛfoɔ no berɛ so.

Na wɔrebɛdwira Yerusalem fasuo no, wɔhwehwɛɛ Lewifoɔ no firi wɔn tenabea nyinaa, sɛ wɔde wɔn reba Yerusalem, na wɔde aseda ne nnwom, nnawuro, mmɛnta ne asankuten adi odwiratwa no anigyeɛ mu. Na nnwontofoɔ mma no boaa wɔn ho ano hyiae firi Yerusalem ho kanko no mu ne Netofafoɔ nkuraase, ne Bet-gilgal ne Geba mfofowa so ne Asmawet, ɛfiri sɛ na nnwontofoɔ no abobɔ nkuraa de atwa Yerusalem ho ahyia. Na asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no dwiraa wɔn ho, na wɔdwiraa ɔman ne kuro apono ne afasuo no.
Na memaa Yuda mmapɔmma no foroo ɔfasuo no, na mede aseda asafokuo akɛseɛ mmienu a wɔnam yuu sisii hɔ, baako faa nifa ɔfasuo no so de kɔɔ Sumina Pono no ano, na Hosaia ne Yuda mmapɔmma fa dii wɔn akyi kɔe ne Asaria, Esra ne Mesulam, Yuda ne Benyamin ne Semaia ne Yeremia, ne asɔfoɔ mma no mu binom a wɔkurakura ntotorobɛnto, Yonatan ba Sakaria, Semaia ba, Matania ba, Mikaia ba, Sakur ba, Asaf ba, ne ne nuanom, Semaia ne Asarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Natanel ne Yuda, Hanani, wɔkurakura Nyankopɔn nipa Dawid nsankuo no, na Ɔtwerɛfoɔ Esra di wɔn anim. Na nsuo Aniwa Pono no so ne wɔn ntentensoɔ no wɔforoo Dawid kuro aforoeɛ no, ɔfasuo no aforoeɛ no so, Dawid fie no atifi de kɔsii Nsuo Pono no ano apueeɛ.
Na aseda asafokuo a ɛtɔ so mmienu no kɔɔ wɔn ntentensoɔ, na me nso medii wɔn akyi, ne ɔman no fa no, ɔfasuo no so de kɔfaa Afononoo Abantenten no so de kɔsii Ɔfasuo Tɛtrɛtɛ no so, de kɔfaa Efraim Pono ne Ɛpono Dada ne Mpataa Pono ne Hananel Abantenten ne Ɔha Abantenten no so de kɔsii Nnwan Pono no ano, na wɔkɔgyinaa Nneduadan Pono no ano. Ɛnna aseda asafokuo mmienu no kɔgyinaa Nyankopɔn fie, me ne mmapɔmma no fa a wɔka me ho, ne asɔfoɔ no: Eliakim, Maaseia, Miniamin, Mikaia, Elioenai, Sakaria, Hanania a wɔkurakura ntotorobɛnto; ne Maaseia, Semaia, Eleasa, Usi, Yehohanan, Malkia, Elam ne Eser; na nnwontofoɔ no memaa wɔn nne so, na Yisrahia ne wɔn so kannifoɔ. Na wɔbobɔɔ afɔdeɛ akɛseɛ da no, na wɔn ani gyee, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn de anigyeɛ kɛseɛ agye wɔn ani; na mmaa ne mmɔfra nso ani gyee, na wɔtee Yerusalem anigyeɛ no nka akyirikyiri.

Na ɛda no ara wɔde mmarima bi sisii akoradeɛ ne mmasoɔ adeɛ ne aduanekan ne ntotosoɔ du du mpia no so, sɛ wɔmmoaboa nkuro no mfuo mu kyɛfa a mmara no hyɛeɛ no ano ngu mu mma asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no, ɛfiri sɛ Yuda nyaa asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ a wɔsisii wɔn no ho anigyeɛ. Na wɔyɛɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn som adwuma ne ahodwira ho som adwuma sɛ nnwontofoɔ ne apono ano ahwɛfoɔ no nso, sɛdeɛ Dawid ne ne ba Salomo hyɛeɛ no. Na tete no, Dawid berɛ so no, na Asaf ne nnwontofoɔ ne Nyankopɔn ayeyie ne aseda so otitire. Na Serubabel ne Nehemia berɛ so no, Israel nyinaa memaa nnwontofoɔ ne apono ano ahwɛfoɔ no kyɛfa, da biara ne ne deɛ, na wɔde akronkronneɛ maa Lewifoɔ, na Lewifoɔ no nso de akronkronneɛ maa Aaron mma.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
